title: Notion: works with everything
how: ffmpeg streamed the video from its URL into cutscene's measure (256 px luma, every frame); nothing saved but these numbers and stills in scratch
whyTopTier: An 18.7 s montage: a dock of app icons over a new background every cut (paintings, the moon, sheep, tapestries), the Notion icon held at the same screen position while every neighbour changes. Cuts shorten from about 0.8 s to 0.35 s, then the Notion icon stands alone, and white cards build 'Any tool. Any agent. Any stack.' → 'Works with everything.'
instrument: Still 87%, 25 shots at a 0.6 s median: a cut montage. No camera moves to fit.

byEye.zoom: the dock fills the frame width; icons at about ×3
byEye.cards: 'Any tool. Any agent.' → '… Any stack.'; 'Works with everything.'; the icon with a pointer
byEye.cursor: a system pointer on the final icon
byEye.frame: full-bleed photos and paintings behind the dock; white for the cards
byEye.sound: an audio track with rhythmic onsets (not listened to)

classify: Montage teaser for an integration story. Conventions: an anchored element across cuts, accelerating cuts, an additive text build, the icon as logo.

diagnose.observation: Notion's icon keeps its screen position across 20 cuts while everything around it changes.
diagnose.principle: The invariant across a montage is the subject: a match cut on position turns 'works with everything' into a picture.

diagnose.observation: Cut interval drops from ~0.8 s to ~0.35 s, then one 1.3 s hold.
diagnose.principle: Accelerating rhythm builds momentum; the first long hold after it lands as the payoff.

diagnose.observation: Cards append a phrase per beat.
diagnose.principle: Additive build: each phrase is read alone before the next joins it.

diagnose.observation: Backgrounds are arbitrary art and photos.
diagnose.principle: Novelty per cut keeps attention, but carries no meaning about the product.

teaches.text: Align consecutive shots on one shared element so every cut is a match cut on its position.
Accelerate the cut rhythm into the payoff.
Additive card build: append one phrase per beat.

critique.like: Holding the icon still while 20 docks change around it says 'works with everything' with no UI at all.
critique.wish: The backgrounds bring novelty but no meaning; app screens behind the dock would carry the same rhythm and say more.
critique.wonder: Could cutscene align consecutive scenes on one locator's box, so the cut between two scenes becomes a match cut?
